breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting' as the numerical method. The ground truth removed the 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only mentions 'Strang splitting' as the time integration method, thus resolving the inconsistency.
